name: Advantech Co., Ltd.
summary: Advantech Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacturing, and marketing of embedded computing boards, industrial automation products, and applied and industrial computers. The company operates through Intelligent Systems; Embedded Design-In; IoT Automation; Intelligent Service; and Advantech Service Plus and Others segments. It offers AIOT software, distribution, and services, application focus embedded, arm-based computing platforms, computer on modules, digital signage players, edge AI and intelligence solutions, embedded PCs and single board computers, fan less embedded computers, gaming platform solutions, industrial display systems, industrial flash and memory,…
